November 27, 2026

Stock Market: U.S. stock markets were closed on November 26 for Thanksgiving. In the previous trading session, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq fell 0.25% and 0.62%, respectively, while the Dow Jones rose 0.33% and Nvidia declined 3.91%. Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index and Hang Seng TECH Index gained 1.19% and 1.16%, respectively. South Korea's KOSPI and KOSDAQ advanced 0.29% and 0.78%, respectively. The Bank of Korea raised its benchmark rate to 3.25%.

Market Commentary: BTC traded at 60,736.6 USDT and ETH at 1,699.89 USDT, both up 0.26% over the past 24 hours, but a reversal of their medium-term weakness remained unconfirmed. Total crypto market capitalization stood at approximately $2.10 trillion, down 2.36% over 24 hours. The Altcoin Season Index was 58, indicating a neutral state, while the Fear and Greed Index was 12, indicating extreme fear. Open interest in Gate BTC and ETH USDT perpetual futures fell 0.24% and rose 4.91%, respectively, over the past 24 hours.

Top-Performing Tokens: INIT, BGSC and ELSA gained 61.54%, 34.49% and 24.59%, respectively, over the past 24 hours. INIT's hourly RSI was 76.27 and open interest in Gate USDT perpetual futures increased 133.63%, warranting continued attention to short-term retracement risks. BGSC and ELSA were approximately 3.81% and 14.06% below their respective highs for the period. Key factors to monitor include selling pressure near those highs, buying support near the lows and trading-volume confirmation.

Alpha Insights: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs recorded approximately $5.39 billion in cumulative net outflows during November, exceeding the previous monthly record, although this was not the final monthly total. The U.S. strategic bitcoin reserve bill became eligible for a full House vote but had not taken effect and did not mandate additional bitcoin purchases. Switzerland approved 57 potential crypto tax information exchange partners, with information exchange planned from 2028 with eligible partners. CARF does not set a uniform tax rate and is not a ban on crypto trading.
